strings.deck_header_hint: click a deck to start studying
strings.empty_hint: Create a deck or download a shared one to get started.
strings.focus_done: Focus session finished — take a break! 🍵
strings.break_done: Break is over — back to your cards! 📚
strings.deck_manage_hint: Pick a deck, then choose an action. Settings save and close so the action's own window can open.
strings.deck_action_failed: That deck action could not be completed.
strings.fsrs_enable_hint: Anki's adaptive scheduler, in place of SM-2
strings.fsrs_enable_note: FSRS learns from your review history to predict when you're about to forget, so intervals track your actual memory. Turning it on recomputes memory state for every card.
strings.fsrs_retention_hint: Higher means more reviews but less forgetting. 90% is a good balance.
strings.fsrs_params_none: None yet — using defaults. Optimize to compute them from your history.
strings.fsrs_params_hint: Optimizing needs a few hundred reviews to mean anything, and is worth rerunning every few weeks. Settings save and close while it runs.
strings.fsrs_params_unchanged: Parameters were already optimal — nothing changed.
strings.fsrs_not_enough_data: Not enough review history to optimize yet — study more and retry.
strings.fsrs_unavailable: This Anki version doesn't include FSRS. Update Anki to use it.
strings.space_to_start: Press Space to start the session
strings.congrats_done: You have finished this deck — nothing left to study right now.
strings.congrats_new_limit: More new cards are waiting, but today's limit is reached.
strings.congrats_review_limit: More reviews are waiting, but today's limit is reached.
strings.events_hint: Upcoming events appear on the dashboard under the greeting with a day countdown. Past events hide themselves.
strings.custom_greeting_hint: Leave empty for a time-of-day greeting
strings.theme_section_hint: Accent colour for buttons, highlights and widgets. Pick one to preview it.
strings.colors_apply_both: Colours apply to both light and dark mode. Changing the accent re-derives the other three; adjust any of them afterwards.
strings.gradient_hint: The gradient paints buttons, pills and progress bars. Text, borders and the heatmap use the colour midway between the two stops.
strings.language_hint: Applies to this add-on's text. Anki's own screens follow Anki's language setting.
strings.anki_lang_prompt:
Switch to {language}?

Anki's own screens change too, so Anki will restart. Declining keeps your current language.
strings.bg_image_hint: Shown behind the dashboard and the deck screen
strings.bg_dim_hint: How much of the theme colour covers the image
strings.bg_hint: The image is copied into the add-on's user_files folder, so it survives updates. The review screen keeps a plain background so answers stay legible.
strings.card_opacity_hint: Lower lets the background show through the cards and sidebar
strings.card_blur_hint: 0 leaves what is behind sharp; higher smears it into colour
strings.cards_hint: Works with or without a background image. At 100% the blocks are solid, as before.
strings.bg_bad_type: That file type is not supported. Pick a JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF or BMP.
strings.bg_too_big: That image is larger than 20 MB. Pick a smaller one.
strings.card_skin_default_hint: Decks added later start with the card skin on. Decks switched off above keep their own setting.
strings.deck_settings_hint: A top-level deck's settings cover every subdeck inside it. Card skin redraws the card in the add-on's design while reviewing; auto-grading lets the clock pick the rating.
strings.auto_grade_info:
Reviewing becomes two keys: ← you didn't know it, → you did.
How long you took then decides between Easy, Good and Hard, and the four rating buttons stay hidden until you ask for them.
strings.auto_grade_hint: The Hard threshold is also how long the countdown runs: when the bar empties, the card is Again. The clock stops whenever Anki is not the active window, so stepping away costs nothing.
strings.auto_grade_needs_chrome: Needs the add-on's own review screen, which draws the countdown. Turn on Appearance → Review screen first.
strings.ag_easy_info: Answer inside this and the card is rated Easy.
strings.ag_good_info: Slower than Easy but inside this, and it is Good.
strings.ag_hard_info: Slower than Good but inside this, and it is Hard. Past it, Again.
strings.ag_deck_own_hint: Off means it follows the deck above it.
strings.reset_settings_hint: Puts every add-on option back to its default. Your cards are untouched.
strings.reset_settings_confirm: Reset all add-on settings to their defaults?
strings.reset_progress_hint: Sends the chosen decks' cards back to new, as if you had just added them.
strings.reset_pick_hint: Cards in the selected decks go back to new. This cannot be undone except from an Anki backup.
strings.reset_pick_confirm: Send {n} cards in {decks} deck(s) back to new?
strings.reset_all_confirm:
This resets everything:

• All {n} cards go back to new
• Your whole review history is deleted — streak, heatmap and retention drop to zero
• Every add-on setting returns to its default

Undo can bring the cards back but not the history, and your next sync will have to upload the whole collection.

Continue?
strings.ob_intro_sub: A calmer home screen for Anki, and a few screens redrawn to match.
strings.ob_feat_1: Stats, an activity heatmap and a Pomodoro timer on one page
strings.ob_feat_2: Deck overview and review screen redrawn to match
strings.ob_feat_3: Six colour themes, light and dark
strings.ob_theme_sub: You can change this any time in Settings.
strings.ob_sidebar_sub: Where your decks live on the dashboard.
strings.ob_skin_sub: The add-on can redraw the answer side from your note's fields.
strings.ob_skin_on_sub: Reading, meanings and notes laid out
strings.ob_look_sub: This switches Anki itself, not just the add-on.
strings.habits_hint: Habit changes save as you make them, not with the Save button. Archiving keeps the history. Minus removes the habit and every day it was ticked.
strings.sched_times_week_hint: Counted by the week: missing a day is fine as long as the week adds up.
strings.habit_delete_confirm: Delete “{name}” and every day it was ticked? This cannot be undone.
strings.habit_empty_hint: Tap + above to add one, then tick it off here every day.
strings.report_empty_hint: Add a habit and it will show up here.
strings.qz_cards_desc: Flip through the deck at your own pace. Nothing is scheduled.
strings.qz_learn_desc: Rounds that get harder as you go, from true or false to typing it out.
strings.qz_test_desc: A fixed number of questions, marked at the end.
strings.qz_match_desc: Pair terms with definitions against the clock.
strings.qz_empty_title: Nothing to study in this deck
strings.qz_empty_body: The study modes need a card with two sides they can tell apart. Cloze and Image Occlusion cards are left to Anki's own reviewer; for anything else, set the term and definition fields in Settings.
strings.qz_resume: Carry on where you left off
strings.qz_flip: Click the card or press Space to flip · ← → to move
strings.qz_learn_done_body: All {total} terms made it through every round.
strings.qz_match_intro: Click a term, then its match. The clock starts on your first click.
strings.qz_types_hint: Question kinds a Test draws from, dealt in turn so a short test still covers each one.
strings.qz_grade_desc: Off by default. When on, only cards already due today are graded — correct counts as Good, wrong as Again. New cards are never introduced from a study mode.
strings.qz_fieldmap_desc: Which fields each mode shows. The first ticked field on a side is the one being asked about — what a typed answer is marked against, what a multiple choice offers, what a Match tile holds — and the rest is shown alongside it. Left alone they are worked out from the card template, which is right for most decks.
strings.qz_where: Adds a Study modes button to every deck's overview. Everything else — which fields go on each side, session lengths, question kinds — is set there, on the deck itself.
